coordinate_convention: Normalized source-canvas regions; crops use original pixel edges, right/bottom exclusive.
scene_crop_note: Remove 0.25 source pixel from each vertical edge for exact 16:9, then one isotropic LANCZOS downsample; original untouched.

heading_zone.status: Conservative visual proposal; contrast, HTML controls and actual slots untested.

wall_control_zone.status: Conservative visual proposal only; tactile texture and illumination remain, so actual control contrast requires testing.

portrait_plan.status: Plan only; no portrait asset shipped or tested.
portrait_plan.composition: Keeps most of the desk/chair and the skylight corner. The right desktop and some floor are deliberately cropped; left heading space is absent.
portrait_plan.heading: Place actual heading above the artwork on a solid theme surface; the art-only crop has no left heading zone.
portrait_plan.390x844_note: Use a bounded artwork region, not a full viewport cover. Actual slot needs testing.

quiet_note: Cooler and more evenly lit still preserves the same room and object layout. Sampled local offsets reach 3.1623px around a paper edge; small generative geometry/detail changes remain, so no pixel-exact registration or crossfade acceptance.
caveats: The actual palette is warm grey stone/ivory with a wooden chair, lighter and warmer than the requested matte graphite; fine plaster texture is visible.
The conservative heading proposal is x=.08-.50, y=.18-.64 (42% of width), not an automatic full-left60% claim; brighter diagonal skylight falloff lies to its right.
The wall retains tactile plaster and soft skylight illumination. Its top-right bevel and stronger bright area should remain outside real controls.
Full 12% overscan is not met: desk right edge and chair legs approach or intersect the canvas. Hero retains the desk/chair core but deliberately crops lower legs and much of the skylight.
Any CSS scrim or solid heading surface is a recommendation only, not tested contrast.
